name: Refugio Otto Meiling on Tronador
region: Nahuel Huapi National Park, Cerro Tronador
why: A hut on a rock ridge at 1,900 m between two of Tronador's glaciers, with the ice field at the door.
book: Book a bed at the hut (Club Andino Bariloche / the hut's office in Bariloche). Nahuel Huapi park fee at the Lago Mascardi ranger post. The gravel road from Los Rápidos to Pampa Linda is one-way by the hour: up only 10:30-14:00, down only 16:00-18:00. A minibus runs from Bariloche in summer.
water: Streams to the Descanso de los Caballos; above it the ridge is dry. Meals and drinks at the hut.
dangers: The last 3 km are on bare rock above the trees, marked only with paint: easy to lose in cloud.
Do not walk onto the glaciers without a guide and crampons.
Weather on Tronador changes fast: wind, rain and snow even in summer.
turnaround: Leave Pampa Linda by 10:00; if you are not at the Descanso de los Caballos by 15:00, turn back.

points.name: Pampa Linda
points.note: Ranger post, hostería and campsite at the end of the road under Tronador. The first 3 km follow a narrow track to the Castaño Overa bridge.

points.name: La Almohadilla
points.note: Top of the forest climb, after about 9 km and 550 m: first open view of Tronador.

points.name: Castaño Overa glacier view
points.note: Near the Descanso de los Caballos at the tree line: the Castaño Overa glacier and its waterfalls. Above, a bare ridge marked with paint.

points.name: Refugio Otto Meiling
points.note: 1,905 m, on the ridge between the Castaño Overa and Alerce glaciers. Meals, bunks and guided walks on the ice.
